name: cx-siren
task: Go to the exit, and whenever the siren rings, turn it off.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the goal should be Existence(at_exit), not ExistenceTwo(at_exit). The task says to reach the exit once; at_exit is a last-step-only condition and there is no wording asking for the exit on two different steps. The ExistenceTwo also leaves the machine without a finishable goal until a second at_exit that the environment can never produce, since the episode ends on the first one. Replace it with a hard Existence(at_exit); keep the hard Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled).
NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) hard requires reaching the exit, and Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) hard requires silencing the siren whenever it rings; together they match the task.

machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!siren_ringing) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u3
(u0, at_exit&siren_ringing&switch_toggled) -> u2
(u1, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u0
(u1, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u3
(u1, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u2
(u3, switch_toggled) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u0, at_exit&!siren_ringing, u2) -> 11
(u0, at_exit&siren_ringing&switch_toggled, u2) -> 11
(u1, !at_exit&switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
(u1, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u3) -> 1
(u1, at_exit&switch_toggled, u2) -> 12
(u3, switch_toggled, u2) -> 11
